1. **Latent growth modeling - Wikipedia** — Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latent_growth_modeling)  
   Defines latent growth modeling as an SEM method for estimating growth trajectories over time, also called latent growth curve analysis, and widely used in psychology and education.

2. **Estimating and visualizing Latent Growth Models with R** — longitudinalanalysis.com

Main topics and subtopics

[PASTE TEXT]

That converter tab is left on the result.
